descriptions: I work in the broad field of data management, and more precisely lmy research interests focus on heterogeneous and/or multimodal data, data integration systems, and data exploration. Recently, I also added Federated Learning to my research interests. The projects that I worked on have always been part of multidisciplinary contexts, including urban planning, journalism, and health, and have been exemplified on large, complex, and often real-world data.
